source.agreementParties: The Majlis Resorts, Lamu Limited and Sunworld Safaris Ltd, at 20% commission

structuralFindings: Priced PER ROOM PER NIGHT (not per person) — a structural difference from every other property in this batch and from all Soroi properties. Room categories: Superior Room, Deluxe Room (both max 3), Junior Suite, Royal Suite (max 4) — 4 categories total, but Junior Suite and Royal Suite are only priced under the 'Per Triple Room (2 Adults 1 Child)' row, i.e. they have no distinct Twin/Double or Single figure on this card.
Two season bands only: 'Year Round' (08 Jan - 20 Dec) and 'Festive period' (21 Dec - 08 Jan, min 5-night stay) — simpler than most beach properties in this batch.

Meal plan differs by season: Year-Round is Half Board (bed, breakfast, a la carte lunch OR dinner); Festive Period is Full Board (bed, breakfast, a la carte lunch AND dinner) — the base meal plan itself changes with season, not just price.

Nett rate confirmed to be a flat ~20.8-21% discount off Rack across most rows (e.g. Superior Twin/Double: 380/480=79.2%; Deluxe Twin/Double: 470/590=79.7%), consistent with the stated 20% commission structure, though not perfectly uniform cell-to-cell — read as printed rather than assuming a single clean multiplier.

Children policy: 0-3 free; 4-11 sharing with 2 adults = 50% of adult; 4-11 in own room = 75% of room rate (max 3 children); single adult + one 4-11 child = Single Room Rate + 50% of adult rate for the child.
Rates stated inclusive of 16% VAT and 2% Room levy — already tax-inclusive, unlike some properties where taxes are added separately.
